freeze_rule: commit all code/config/protocol after development, then only previously unused validation seeds; no rerun or threshold selection from validation
unchanged_baseline: same prior/initialization, raw-minus-P1 once, signed pseudo-Huber, Odom pose translation, gyro/bias process for F3,20s lag,1s keyframe/wait,+/-0.4s medians/min5,TRF max50 tolerances1e-7

controller.score: abs(corrected aggregated link - excluded-from-start shadow range)/.20m; engineering not calibrated NIS/PL
controller.reference: same F0/F3 skeleton, independent per-wall history/prior; other UWB original pseudo-Huber only gain1; no copying main prior
controller.known_condition: shadow accepted/full numeric rank, F3 angular covered,>=3 other current walls,XY H singular ratio>=.15; otherwise unknown
controller.unknown: reset persistence, hold previous policy gain; initialunknown gain1 explicitly not healthy; missing actualgain null
controller.weight_application: sqrt(g) multiplies original pseudo-Huber residual/J once, frozen at first graph entry; zero-info rows explicit; no rollback, switching, or bias reset/locking

generator.initial_prior: old geometry/P1; declared heading170deg, true initial displacement sigma[.10m,.10m,3deg], Odom source pose startszero
generator.noise_streams: separate seeded streams keep nominal draws paired across scenarios; same exact input across allQ groups
generator.gyro_drift: true gyro bias ramps0to+.025rad/s [12,22), holdto32, rampsbackto0 [32,37); UWB healthy
generator.odom_turn_bias: odom angularrate +.025 [12,32), integrated into Odom.pose; gyro and UWB healthy
generator.common_turn_error: both Odom and gyro angularrate +.025 [12,32), shared correlated error; effective gyro residual bias target includes it
generator.multi_common_uwb: all4 walls +.30m [12,32), each link event plus one common cause
generator.weak_missing: retain node2/node3 [12,32); node3 also absent[20,24); all recover32
generator.interpretation: exploratory synthetic faults, not an asserted real sensor failure distribution

evaluation.state_errors: all finite publications incl warmup/unknown/failed predictions, XY/yaw/bias, common-valid alongside all coverage; no endpoint fitting
evaluation.exceedance_time: 1s per scheduled state sample, explicit state-domain diagnostic, never independent trials
evaluation.availability: paced host monotonic data-flush time mapped to declared source receive origin; includes1s waiting, shadow,monitor,main,logging/scheduling/queue; not hardware ROS latency calibration
evaluation.exposure: actual output intervals[first available,last available); last sample zero exposure, no EOF extrapolation; per link and seed
evaluation.normal_false_events: nominal attenuation and disabled contiguous episodes, reported separately with monitorable linkseconds/unknown denominator; episode escalation not independent experiment
evaluation.fault_events: each injected UWB target-link episode; all denominator and >=2 consecutive monitorable state decisions denominator; non-UWB fault cases report healthy-UWB misattribution separately
evaluation.detected: new or escalated known-score gain reduction on target during source fault interval; preexisting alert separately flagged; historical/active availability detection distinguished
evaluation.recovery: first normal gain1 followed by2 more known normal decisions after fault end, actual available-time delay; null if not detected/censored
evaluation.error_vs_detection: paired Q2-Q0/Q3-Q1 errors/exceedance and early32-52/late52-60 recovery; alert does not imply limited error
evaluation.independence: summarize by seed; no correlated-frame independent count or low-risk guarantee
evaluation.audit: all ledger/score/state/weights/source/cutoff/history checks, all available costs, every7th marginal per graph finite-differenced; resigned bad logs must fail

resume: case-boundary only with exact code/protocol/input/output SHA; unindexed partial cells preserved and never silently rerun; no full filter restoration claim
